title: Two ways tonight ends
style: Cinematic still from a quiet indie drama, vertical 9:16, shot on 35mm film, natural motivated light, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, realistic skin, restrained colour. No text, no logos, no visible screen content. Fully clothed, non-sexual.
hero: Reference portrait of the film's lead: a man around 30, short dark hair, light stubble, kind tired eyes, plain heather-grey t-shirt, neutral expression, soft window light, plain dark background, chest-up.

shots.frame: At night in a dark bedroom, he lies in bed propped on a pillow, scrolling his phone; the cold blue glow of the screen is the only light on his face; he looks lonely and restless.
shots.motion: Slow push-in on his face as he keeps scrolling; his thumb moves, his eyes are tired; quiet room tone, faint city hum.

shots.frame: Extreme close-up of his face lit by the phone, eyes fixed on the screen, a flicker of hesitation; the rest of the frame falls to black.
shots.motion: Almost still; he swallows, his eyes narrow, a breath held; the room sound drops away.

shots.frame: Over-the-shoulder from behind him in bed at night, the phone screen is a bright out-of-focus blur of light, nothing on it readable; cold desaturated blue tones.
shots.motion: The camera drifts slowly closer to the blurred screen while he stays motionless; cold, hollow ambience.

shots.frame: Grey early morning, he sits on the edge of the unmade bed, elbows on knees, head down, phone face up on the sheets beside him; drained, desaturated, overcast window light.
shots.motion: Static wide shot; he rubs his face slowly and stares at the floor; muted, empty silence.

shots.frame: Over-the-shoulder from behind him in bed at night, his phone screen glows a calm deep violet (plain, no text), he has stopped scrolling and is looking at it, surprised.
shots.end: Extreme close-up over his shoulder at night: his phone, held upright in his hand, fills most of the frame, screen facing the camera squarely and parallel to the lens, the screen a plain calm deep violet with nothing on it; his thumb at the lower edge of the phone; soft violet light on his fingers; the bedroom dark and out of focus behind.
shots.motion: One smooth, slow camera push-in over his shoulder toward the phone in his hand until the screen fills the frame, then the camera comes to rest; he holds the phone still; quiet room tone.

shots.frame: Medium close-up at night, he sits up in bed, eyes closed, taking a slow deep breath, phone lowered in his hand on the blanket; a warm bedside lamp now on beside him.
shots.motion: He breathes in slowly, holds, and breathes out; his shoulders drop and his face softens into calm; he opens his eyes and puts the phone face down on the nightstand.

shots.frame: Vertical portrait framing with the camera held upright and the horizon level (not rotated). Waist-up, he fills the middle of the frame. Early next morning, he jogs along a quiet tree-lined street at sunrise in a dark running top, golden low sun behind him, breath visible in the cool air, a small easy smile, energised and clear-headed.
shots.motion: Tracking shot alongside him as he runs at an easy pace into the sunrise; he breathes out and smiles to himself; footsteps, birdsong, a quiet morning street.

shots.frame: Bright warm kitchen, he laughs at the table over coffee with his partner across from him (she is soft-focus in the foreground), morning sun, real connection.
shots.motion: He laughs at something she says and leans in; natural handheld camera; warm kitchen sounds.
